question: The Kathakali dance form originated in which part of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kathakali** is a traditional dance form that originated in the **southern state of Kerala** in India.
 
• It is a highly stylized form of dance-drama that involves intricate facia
